title: Drift: Leveraging Distribution-based Dynamic Precision Quantization for Efficient Deep Neural Network Acceleration
problem: Existing static quantization methods fail to sufficiently utilize sparsity and redundancy in exponentially growing DNN models (240× growth in two years), and current precision-flexible accelerators cannot support dynamic precision execution.
motivation: As DNN models grow dramatically with the emergence of large language models, dynamic quantization techniques are needed to achieve better hardware-efficiency for inference beyond static quantization approaches.
method: The paper proposes a dynamic precision quantization algorithm that exploits pervasive dynamism in data tensors across DNN models. A novel Drift accelerator is designed with online scheduling to efficiently support dynamic precision execution across CNN and Transformer architectures.
key_novelty: Distribution-based dynamic precision quantization that adapts precision levels online based on tensor statistics rather than using fixed precision throughout the model.
contributions: Dynamic precision quantization algorithm leveraging tensor distribution characteristics
Drift accelerator architecture supporting online dynamic precision execution
Online scheduling mechanism for dynamic precision support
2.85× speedup and 3.12× energy savings compared to static precision-flexible accelerators
primary_theme: dynamic precision quantization for DNN inference acceleration
